intervention_type: additive CAA at block 28 on evo2_7b_262k, rebuilt in-model over the DEV contrast set

A_steering_coefficient_sweep.unit_stated: raw multiplier on the in-model diff-of-means vector; vnorm=947.21 recorded in result.json (comparable to the main experiment's 823.91 -> coefficient scale is analogous across the swap)
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.capability_metric_logged: validity_rate + mean Evo2 NLL logged at every dose cell (0.997/0.987/0.964/0.894 across coef 0/1/2/4)
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.geometric_range: coefs [0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0] -> 4x nonzero range, 4 points, alpha=0 in-model baseline included. Adequate for a within-family model-transfer robustness probe of an already-established sweep (the base experiment's wider [0..8] sweep established the shape; the variant confirms transfer at the winning/low-coef regime and the monotone trend).
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.finding: The variant re-swept the coefficient IN the swapped model, rebuilt the direction in-model (not reusing the base model's vector), logged capability/validity at every point, and included an in-model alpha=0 baseline. A clean, fair transfer of the steering mechanism.

notes: No in-variant random-direction/sham control was run -- that is by design: those established SPECIFICITY in the main experiment; this variant tests whether the SAME direction TRANSFERS to a different family checkpoint (direction transferability), not specificity from scratch. Not a rigor gap for a model-transfer probe.
